pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding allowed unless the initial position is in-the-money by at least 1.5x the maximum risk unit and trailing stop is locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 3-timeframe alignment filter (M1, M5, M15) combined with volume delta confirmation before firing any order to prevent high-impact wick entrapment.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00, trail remaining balance aggressively using ATR-based trailing stops to capture $15-$30+ runs.
